source.label: thm:lower-bound-full
source.quote: For any federated bandit algorithm $\pi$, there exists a graph $\mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V}, \mathcal{E})$ with Laplacian matrix $M$ and a full-information feedback instance $L\in [0, 1]^{T\times N\times K}$ such that for some $v_1 \in \mathcal{V}$, $R^{v_1}_T(\pi, L) = \Omega \left(\sqrt[4]{\frac{1+d_{\max}}{\lambda_{N-1}(M)}}\sqrt{T\log K}\right).$

results.notes: Regret is expectation over randomness with oblivious losses (expected = pseudo regret here). The graph is existentially chosen, not arbitrary. Proof via Lemma A.4: (1-o(1))/4 sqrt((Delta~+1) T log K /2) as T->inf.

symbols.d_max: maximum degree of the communication graph
symbols.lam_conn: second smallest eigenvalue lambda_{N-1}(M) of the graph Laplacian

source.label: thm:lower-bound-bandit
source.quote: For any federated bandit algorithm $\pi$, there exists a graph $\mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V}, \mathcal{E})$ with Laplacian matrix $M$ and a bandit feedback instance $L\in [0, 1]^{T\times N\times K}$ such that for some $v_1 \in \mathcal{V}$, $R^{v_1}_T(\pi, L)= \Omega\left( \max\left\{ \sqrt{ \frac{1}{1+d_{v_1}}}\sqrt{KT}, \sqrt[4]{\frac{1+d_{\max}}{\lambda_{N-1}(M)} } \sqrt{T\log K} \right\} \right).$

results.notes: Appendix proof gives the more precise form Omega(min{T, max{...} sqrt(T)}); the first term relies on Shamir (2014) with stochastic losses.

symbols.sigma_2_W: second largest singular value of the gossip matrix W
symbols.C_W: min{2 log T + log N, sqrt(N)}/(1-sigma_2(W)) + 3

conditions: W is a doubly stochastic gossip matrix supported on the communication graph edges
tuning: eta_t = log K/(T gamma_T) = ((log K)^2/((C_W+1/2) K^2 T^2))^(1/3)
C_W = min{2 log T + log N, sqrt(N)}/(1-sigma_2(W)) + 3

source.label: thm:upper-bound:static
source.quote: Assume that the network runs Algorithm~\ref{algo:FedExp3} with $\gamma_t = \sqrt[3]{\frac{\left(C_W + \frac{1}{2}\right)K^2\log K}{t}}$ and $\eta_t = \frac{\log K}{T \gamma_T}$ ... with $C_W = \min\{2\log T + \log N, \sqrt{N}\}/(1-\sigma_2(W)) +3.$ Then, the expected regret of each agent $v\in \mathcal{V}$ is bounded as $R_T^v = \Tilde{O} \left( \frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{1-\sigma_2(W)}} K^{2/3} T^{2/3}\right)$

results.notes: Holds for every agent simultaneously. Proof yields explicit bound 5 (C_W K^2 log K)^(1/3) T^(2/3). With max-degree gossip matrix, (1-sigma_2)^(-1/3) <= (2(d_max+1)/lambda_{N-1}(M))^(1/3).
